## 4. The verdict

- On the frozen surface the v3 adapter is the ONLY arm that improves on its own base model on every public benchmark: cti-mcq +2.04 pp; cti-rcm +22.60 pp; cybermetric-500 +33.20 pp; harmbench_harmful_compliance_pct -0.63 pp; mitre_frr_refusal_pct +24.94 pp; secqa-v1-test +25.46 pp.
- On the equal-terms CTI-MCQ ladder (one runner, one population, one parser) v3 reads 0.6404 at 2,048 against the base's 0.4408 and the public comparator's 0.5776 — the adapter is the source of the whole gap.
- On the harmful side the adapter is also better than its base: HarmBench standard-test harmful compliance -0.63 pp (lower is better), i.e. it removed the base's one harmful completion rather than adding any.
- The v3 adapter's ONE measured liability is the false-refusal side: MITRE-FRR +24.94 pp over the base. That is a refusal-DOSE problem, which is exactly what the rebuilt corpus's 4.91 % refusal share (decision W-3) and its 3,304 format-compliance rows exist to fix — not an adapter defect.
- The arms that ARE failures are v1 and v2: v1 scores 0.0000 on CTI-RCM (1,000 of 1,000 unparseable) and below the always-C floor on CTI-MCQ, and v2 arm A/B collapse across the board. 'The previously-failed adapter' is v1/v2, not v3.

### And still: do not warm-start from it

**the new arm trains from the BASE checkpoint, not from the v3 adapter.**

- The F-8 trace says the held-out contamination reaches v3's own SFT file and training mixture. A warm start would ship weights that were partly trained on the 604 rows containing the held-out questions — so the new arm's own held-out measurement would be compromised at the source, before a single new row is seen.
- The v3 adapter also carries the OLD corpus's imprint: the old refusal share (not the 4.91 % of W-3) and the old mixture. The rebuilt corpus exists to fix those; resuming v3 would partially undo the fix at step one.
- The adapter's capability contribution is a DATA effect, not a weight effect: it is reproducible by training the same recipe on the rebuilt mixture, which carries MORE relevant supervision (the 245,273-row NVD triage family, which the old corpus did not contain at all).
- Cold start keeps the shipped artefact reproducible from one recipe, one corpus and one base checkpoint — which is what the release manifest and the model card have to claim.
